name: ac-trading-records-and-tax
description: Keeping trading and investing records in a form that survives tax review, and assembling the annual pack a professional can work from: per-trade records, cost-basis methods, reconciliation to venue statements, the jurisdiction questions to ask, crypto-specific issues, pack assembly, and the pre-submission audit. It organises records and questions; it is not tax advice and never computes a liability. Use when asking "trade records", "cost basis", "tax pack", "what should I keep", "accountant handoff", "crypto tax records". Not for computing tax (consult a professional), not for the trade decision record (ac-crypto-trading-discipline), not for portfolio policy (ac-investment-policy-statement).
